ArtisticAllySpeaking is a Face painter, body painter, Special Effects (SFX) makeup artist,  singer-songwriter and music producer.
Biography
Ally was born on 15th October 1996 in Victoria Hospital, Candos, Quatre-Bornes. Mauritius
Career
Has been working as a freelance face painter from 2017 to present.
Works
* Youth Staff on MSC Cruise ships: Preziosa, Grandiosa, Magnifica, Meraviglia, Seaview, Seascape, Seashore.
